summary.text: Andy Ogles represents Tennessee's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: A Middle Tennessee native, he graduated from Franklin High School and earned a degree from Middle Tennessee State University.
Before Congress he owned restaurants and a real estate investment business, worked for Americans for Prosperity and the Laffer Center, and served as Mayor of Maury County starting in 2018.
He lives on a farm south of Columbia with his wife and three children.
